---
title: "Specify cache lifetime for user browsers"
sidebarTitle: "Configure browser caching"
ai-navigation: Configure browser cache lifetime on a CDN resource via the Customer Portal, REST API, or Terraform.
---

import { MethodSwitch, MethodSection } from "/snippets/method-switch.jsx";

<MethodSwitch>
  <MethodSection id="portal" label="Customer Portal">

<p>The Browser caching option controls how long CDN content is stored in end users' browsers. Two modes are available: **Origin controlled** and **CDN controlled**.</p>

<p>Use **Origin controlled** when the origin server already manages browser cache duration through response headers. Use **CDN controlled** to set a fixed browser cache lifetime independently of the origin headers.</p>

<p>When **Origin controlled** is active, the origin determines browser cache behavior through its response headers. Gcore CDN passes the origin's `Cache-Control` header to browsers unchanged.</p>

<p>If the origin sends no `Cache-Control`, browsers may apply heuristic caching when a `Last-Modified` header is present. If neither header is present, the browser does not cache the response.</p>

<p>When **CDN controlled** is active, Gcore CDN overrides the origin cache headers and sets the lifetime on the response:</p>

- `Cache-Control` — sets the maximum browser cache time. A 12-hour lifetime returns `Cache-Control: max-age=43200`.
- `Expires` — calculated from the current time plus the `max-age` value.

<Note>
  Browser caching applies to responses with codes 200, 201, 204, 206, 301, 302, 303, 304, 307, 308. Responses with other codes will not be cached.
</Note>

## Configure browser caching

<p>Configure browser caching on a CDN resource:</p>

<Steps>
  <Step title="Navigate to CDN resources">
    In the [Gcore Customer Portal](https://portal.gcore.com), navigate to **CDN** > **CDN resources** and click the CNAME of the required resource.

    <Frame>
      ![CDN resources list with custom domain names](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers-image1.png)
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Open browser caching settings">
    In the **Cache** section, click **Browser caching**.

    <Frame>
      ![CDN resource settings with Browser caching toggle enabled and Origin controlled dropdown](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers-image2.png)
    </Frame>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Enable the toggle">
    Turn on the **Enable browser caching** toggle.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Select the caching mode">
    From the dropdown, select **Origin controlled** or **CDN controlled**. If Origin controlled is selected, the configuration is complete — proceed to save. For CDN controlled, configure the cache lifetime using the expandable block.

    <Accordion title="Configure CDN controlled mode">
      In the **Cache expiry** list, select a cache lifetime. The list marks four days as recommended.

      <Frame>
        ![Cache expiry dropdown in CDN controlled mode showing duration options](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers-image3.png)
      </Frame>

      To set a duration not in the list, select **Custom value** and enter the lifetime in seconds. To keep the response for one day, enter `86400`.

      <Frame>
        ![Custom value field in CDN controlled mode](/images/docs/cdn/cdn-resource-options/cache/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers/specify-cache-lifetime-for-user-browsers-image4.png)
      </Frame>
    </Accordion>
  </Step>

  <Step title="Save">
    Click **Save changes**.
  </Step>
</Steps>

</MethodSection>
  <MethodSection id="api" label="REST API">

<p>Set `options.browser_cache_settings` on a CDN resource. **Origin controlled** is selected in the Customer Portal. `enabled` `true` with `value` sets the CDN controlled lifetime. Find the resource ID in [list&nbsp;CDN&nbsp;resources](/api-reference/cdn/cdn-resources/list-cdn-resources).</p>

<Info>
An [API&nbsp;token](/account-settings/api-tokens) is required.
</Info>

```bash
export GCORE_API_KEY="{YOUR_API_KEY}"
export CDN_RESOURCE_ID="{YOUR_RESOURCE_ID}"
```

## Cache lifetime

<p>Send `enabled` true and `value` `4d` to store a four-day CDN controlled lifetime. For a custom lifetime, set `value` to a string of seconds. `86400` is one day.</p>

<Note>
`value` is required. A duration above `1y` returns HTTP 400.
</Note>

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Python SDK">
    ```python
    import os

    from gcore import Gcore

    client = Gcore()
    resource_id = int(os.environ["CDN_RESOURCE_ID"])

    resource = client.cdn.cdn_resources.update(
        resource_id,
        options={
            "browser_cache_settings": {"enabled": True, "value": "4d"},
        },
    )
    print(resource.options.browser_cache_settings.enabled, resource.options.browser_cache_settings.value)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Go SDK">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "strconv"

        gcore "github.com/G-Core/gcore-go"
        "github.com/G-Core/gcore-go/cdn"
    )

    func main() {
        client := gcore.NewClient()
        ctx := context.Background()
        resourceID, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("CDN_RESOURCE_ID"), 10, 64)
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }

        resource, err := client.CDN.CDNResources.Update(ctx, resourceID, cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParams{
            Options: cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParamsOptions{
                BrowserCacheSettings: cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParamsOptionsBrowserCacheSettings{
                    Enabled: true,
                    Value:   "4d",
                },
            },
        })
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        fmt.Println(resource.Options.BrowserCacheSettings.Enabled, resource.Options.BrowserCacheSettings.Value)
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="curl">
    ```bash
    curl -X PATCH "https://api.gcore.com/cdn/resources/$CDN_RESOURCE_ID" \
      -H "Authorization: APIKey $GCORE_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{
        "options": {
          "browser_cache_settings": {
            "enabled": true,
            "value": "4d"
          }
        }
      }'
    ```

    <p>The API returns HTTP 200:</p>

    ```json
    {
      "id": 12345,
      "options": {
        "browser_cache_settings": {
          "enabled": true,
          "value": "4d"
        }
      }
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Turn browser caching off

<p>Set `enabled` to `false` and still send `value`. Browser caching turns off, and the stored `value` remains.</p>

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Python SDK">
    ```python
    import os

    from gcore import Gcore

    client = Gcore()
    resource_id = int(os.environ["CDN_RESOURCE_ID"])

    resource = client.cdn.cdn_resources.update(
        resource_id,
        options={
            "browser_cache_settings": {"enabled": False, "value": "4d"},
        },
    )
    print(resource.options.browser_cache_settings.enabled, resource.options.browser_cache_settings.value)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Go SDK">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "strconv"

        gcore "github.com/G-Core/gcore-go"
        "github.com/G-Core/gcore-go/cdn"
    )

    func main() {
        client := gcore.NewClient()
        ctx := context.Background()
        resourceID, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("CDN_RESOURCE_ID"), 10, 64)
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }

        resource, err := client.CDN.CDNResources.Update(ctx, resourceID, cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParams{
            Options: cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParamsOptions{
                BrowserCacheSettings: cdn.CDNResourceUpdateParamsOptionsBrowserCacheSettings{
                    Enabled: false,
                    Value:   "4d",
                },
            },
        })
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        fmt.Println(resource.Options.BrowserCacheSettings.Enabled, resource.Options.BrowserCacheSettings.Value)
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="curl">
    ```bash
    curl -X PATCH "https://api.gcore.com/cdn/resources/$CDN_RESOURCE_ID" \
      -H "Authorization: APIKey $GCORE_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{
        "options": {
          "browser_cache_settings": {
            "enabled": false,
            "value": "4d"
          }
        }
      }'
    ```

    <p>The API returns HTTP 200. The saved option is:</p>

    ```json
    {
      "enabled": false,
      "value": "4d"
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</MethodSection>
  <MethodSection id="terraform" label="Terraform">

<p>Set how long browsers keep a CDN response with the [Terraform&nbsp;provider](/developer-tools/terraform/overview) v2. **Origin controlled** is selected in the Customer Portal. With `enabled` set to `true`, `value` is the CDN controlled lifetime: the CDN overrides origin cache headers, sends `Cache-Control` with `max-age`, and sets `Expires` to the current time plus that `max-age`.</p>

<p>The lifetime applies to responses `200`, `201`, `204`, `206`, `301`, `302`, `303`, `304`, `307`, and `308`. Other codes are not cached. A duration above `1y` returns HTTP 400.</p>

## Set a CDN controlled lifetime

<p>Set `enabled` to `true` and `value` to `4d` to keep responses in the browser for four days. The CDN sends `Cache-Control: max-age=345600`.</p>

<p>Edit `value` and run `terraform apply` to change the lifetime.</p>

```hcl
resource "gcore_cdn_origin_group" "example" {
  name = "my-origin-group"

  sources = [
    {
      source  = "example.com"
      enabled = true
    }
  ]
}

resource "gcore_cdn_resource" "example" {
  cname           = "cdn.example.com"
  origin_group    = gcore_cdn_origin_group.example.id
  origin_protocol = "HTTPS"

  options = {
    browser_cache_settings = {
      enabled = true
      value   = "4d"
    }
  }
}
```

## Set a lifetime in seconds

<p>Set `value` to `86400` for a one-day lifetime in seconds. The CDN sends `Cache-Control: max-age=86400`.</p>

```hcl
resource "gcore_cdn_origin_group" "example" {
  name = "my-origin-group"

  sources = [
    {
      source  = "example.com"
      enabled = true
    }
  ]
}

resource "gcore_cdn_resource" "example" {
  cname           = "cdn.example.com"
  origin_group    = gcore_cdn_origin_group.example.id
  origin_protocol = "HTTPS"

  options = {
    browser_cache_settings = {
      enabled = true
      value   = "86400"
    }
  }
}
```

## Turn browser caching off

<p>Set `enabled` to `false` and keep `value` in the same object. The next `terraform apply` turns browser caching off, and the stored `value` remains.</p>

```hcl
resource "gcore_cdn_origin_group" "example" {
  name = "my-origin-group"

  sources = [
    {
      source  = "example.com"
      enabled = true
    }
  ]
}

resource "gcore_cdn_resource" "example" {
  cname           = "cdn.example.com"
  origin_group    = gcore_cdn_origin_group.example.id
  origin_protocol = "HTTPS"

  options = {
    browser_cache_settings = {
      enabled = false
      value   = "4d"
    }
  }
}
```

</MethodSection>
</MethodSwitch>
